meta.note: dev-a and dev-b patch item-1's `meaning` at the exact same `at`. The tiebreak is deterministic by device id, not by which patch happens to arrive (or replay) last: `patches_of` orders dev-a before dev-b, so a refold applies dev-a's patch then dev-b's, and dev-b's value must win however the two events are delivered. dev-b's patch also sets `notes`, which dev-a's patch does not name, so `notes` must survive the tie.
